name: omp-kata
description: kata issue-tracker integration for omp: agent contract, per-agent identity, inbox delivery, attention lifecycle

executable.description: kata executable (name on PATH or absolute path)

contract.description: Inject the kata agent contract into the system prompt (inside kata workspaces only)

contractSource.description: Passed as --source to `kata agent-contract-hook` when non-empty (replaces the built-in contract text)

inbox.description: Deliver kata inbox requests to the agent as <kata_inbox> messages

inboxPollSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between mid-turn/idle inbox checks; 0 checks after every tool result

wakeOnInbox.description: An idle main session starts a turn when new inbox requests arrive (otherwise it only notifies)

attention.description: Start kata attention tracking on claim / KATA_REF and end it when the session ends

identity.description: Give each agent its own kata identity (actor/teammate/inbox address) via a PATH shim; false leaves kata untouched

omp.description: kata issue-tracker integration for omp: agent contract, per-agent identity, inbox delivery, attention lifecycle
